title: FDA carried out the second most veterinary company inspections in Oklahoma in Q1
text:
The FDA conducted inspections at 12 different veterinary companies in Oklahoma during the first quarter of 2026, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
Veterinary companies accounted for the second highest number of FDA inspections by company type in Oklahoma, representing 42.9% of all inspections conducted in the state during this period.
Among Oklahoma’s veterinary companies, 6K Family LP and Fred Wilkins received the highest number of FDA citations in the first quarter of 2026.
The FDA routinely inspects facilities across the nation to determine if the workplace and their products are compliant with FDA-regulated laws and regulations implemented to improve overall public health. Inspection results are then disclosed publicly.
According to its website , the FDA is a government agency that is primarily responsible for monitoring the production and distribution of human and animal drugs, biological products, medical supplies and tobacco products for safety and quality.
